messages:
Nora: idea: replace the flat list of network probes with a compact probe timeline that shows attempt history (last 3 tries) and a single-line summary + expandable advanced details. gives context for flakey networks. thoughts?
Diego: like it. timeline helps surface intermittent failures vs persistent ones. visual: small dots with timestamps + a status icon, and a summary pill: '2 of 3 attempts succeeded'. clicking the pill opens a details panel with logs/commands.
Kai: impl notes: timeline should be lightweight SVG/CSS. advanced details must be lazy-loaded. prefer not to auto-open full logs unless user expands. auto-open summary pill on first hard failure.
Yuna: accessibility: timeline svg needs descriptive text and each dot should be keyboard focusable with sr-only labels like 'attempt 1: timeout, 14:22'. the summary pill needs aria-expanded + aria-controls. when we auto-open the details panel, move focus into the panel and provide a visible close button with clear label.
Nora: UX nuance: we have novice users who want clear next steps and platform admins who want raw commands. propose role-aware copy: default view shows plain-language steps and a single 'Run diagnostics' button. advanced (admin) view exposes commands and full logs. detect role by workspace metadata but always allow toggling to advanced.
Diego: copy suggestions — default summary header: 'Connection status: intermittent'. body: 'Some attempts succeeded. Try retrying or open diagnostics for details.' advanced header: 'Detailed connection timeline'. inside advanced: include prefilled diagnostic commands, copy buttons, and a small 'Explain this output' inline help link.
Kai: security note: do not include any customer secrets in logs. redact IPs in examples and ensure copy buttons copy only safe snippets. also rate-limit live probe polling when details panel is open to avoid extra load.
Yuna: screenreader announcements: put a polite aria-live region outside the collapsible panel that reports high-level status updates like 'Connection status changed: intermittent' and only announce state changes, not every probe. for copy confirmation use role='status' so screen readers get 'Copied to clipboard' when a copy button is used.
Nora: behavior on user preference: if a non-admin opens advanced view, persist choice for that user for the session. if an admin toggles it, persist across sessions. log preference events for analytics.
Diego: microcopy tweak: avoid unexplained acronyms. where we must use terms like CIDR or SSH, include a tooltip with short definition and a 'Learn more' KB link. translations: avoid idioms, keep sentences short for localization.
Kai: telemetry we should emit: probe_timeline_viewed, advanced_opened_by_role, copy_cmd_clicked, timeline_auto_opened_reason (e.g., persistent_fail). include anonymized failure codes.
Yuna: final a11y checklist: timeline keyboard order, focus management on auto-open, aria-live outside hidden content, copy confirmations announced, non-color indicators + contrast, meaningful alt text for svg.
Nora: decision: prototype timeline + role-aware defaults. collapsed advanced by default for non-admins, auto-open summary pill on first persistent failure, persist toggles per role, lazy-load logs. Diego will mock screens and share a Figma link.
